overview: Close the remaining auth gaps: password reset link, Google social login (server-redirect via expo-web-browser), sign-up flow (signUpOtp), and biometric authentication (expo-local-authentication).

scopeCuts: Focus on auth parity inside mobile auth routes, hooks/store, and account client
Exclude server-side OAuth provider config, new server endpoints, enterprise SSO

prerequisites: Existing scaffold/auth/api client phases are already implemented in mobile/
AccountClient supports login, validateOtp, verify2fa, getUserWorkspaces, signUpOtp, requestPasswordReset
expo-secure-store is already configured for token persistence
expo-web-browser is already installed (for OAuth server-redirect)
expo-linking is already installed (for redirect URL capture)
nonGoals: Client-side OAuth token exchange (server uses Passport.js server-redirect)
contracts: Google OAuth uses WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync() with server redirect pattern
Signup uses signUpOtp() (not deprecated signUp()), requiring OTP verification
New auth routes stay under mobile/src/app/(auth)/**
Existing login/OTP/2FA flows must not regress

tasks.title: Add password reset / forgot password flow
tasks.description: Add a Forgot Password link on the login screen that triggers the server's password reset email flow via AccountClient.requestPasswordReset().
acceptanceCriteria: Login screen shows a Forgot Password link below the password field that navigates to a reset screen.
Reset screen calls AccountClient.requestPasswordReset() and shows a success confirmation regardless of whether the email is registered (prevents email enumeration).
A Resend button appears after 30s for users who did not receive the email.

tasks.title: Add Google social login
tasks.description: Add a Continue with Google button using the server's Passport.js redirect flow via WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync(). NOT expo-auth-session (server handles OAuth, not client).
acceptanceCriteria: Login screen shows a Continue with Google button that calls WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync() to open {accountsUrl}/auth/google with the app return URL.
On redirect back, the token is extracted from the ?token=... query parameter and proceeds to workspace selection.
OAuth failure, user cancellation, or browser dismissal returns to login with no partial auth state persisted.

tasks.title: Add sign-up / create account flow
tasks.description: Add a sign-up screen using signUpOtp() (not the deprecated signUp()). Signup sends a verification email, then routes to the existing OTP screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Login screen shows a Create Account link that navigates to a signup form (first name, last name, email).
Successful signup calls AccountClient.signUpOtp() which sends a verification email, then routes to the existing OTP screen for email confirmation.
Duplicate email or validation errors show recoverable inline errors without losing entered form data.

tasks.title: Add biometric authentication (Face ID / Touch ID)
tasks.description: Add optional biometric unlock using expo-local-authentication after initial login so returning users skip password entry.
acceptanceCriteria: After successful login, users are prompted to enable biometric unlock (opt-in, stored in expo-secure-store). Uses expo-local-authentication.
On app launch with valid stored token, biometric prompt appears; success proceeds to workspace, failure falls back to password.
Devices without biometric hardware (LocalAuthentication.hasHardwareAsync() returns false) skip the prompt entirely without error.

failureModes.recovery: Auth state stays on login screen; no partial auth state persisted
Show Login failed error; do not attempt to parse empty token
Show Resend button after 30s; suggest checking spam

failureModes.detection: Biometric succeeds but API rejects token
failureModes.recovery: Clear biometric enrollment and fall back to password login

failureModes.detection: Server returns duplicate error via signUpOtp
failureModes.recovery: Show inline error on email field, preserve other form data

testCoverageMap: TASK-001: reset email send + always-success confirmation + resend button
TASK-002: WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync redirect + token extraction + cancellation recovery
TASK-003: signUpOtp form + duplicate email error + OTP routing
TASK-004: expo-local-authentication enrollment + success/failure + no-hardware fallback
